title: runic configuration file
description: Single-file configuration for the runic scheduler. Validated on startup; unknown fields are rejected.

host.description: Address to bind the server to.

env.description: Environment variables injected into all action commands.

timeout.description: Global action timeout in seconds (per-action timeout overrides this).

data_dir.description: Directory holding runic.db and logs. Relative paths resolve against the config file's directory.

clean_days.description: Delete history records older than N days.

max_log_num.description: Keep at most N most recent log files.

actions.description: Actions keyed by id. Ids must not start with '@' (reserved for system actions).

tags.description: Tags identifying this server. An action runs here if any of its tags matches. Overridden by RUNIC_TAGS.

timeout.description: Per-action timeout in seconds, overrides the global timeout.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron expression. Must be quoted if it starts with '*'.

concurrency.description: Max overlapping runs. Defaults to 1; 0 means unlimited.

tags.description: Which servers run this action. "*" runs everywhere; absent runs nowhere. Otherwise runs where any tag matches the server's tags.
